question: The oath of office to the Vice-President is administered by the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The oath of office to the Vice-President of India is administered by the **President of India**.
 
• This ceremony usually takes place in the Central Hall of Parliament.
 
• The Vice-President, before entering upon his office, makes and subscribes to an oath or affirmation.
 
• In the oath, the Vice-President swears to bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India and to discharge the duties of his office faithfully.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Justice of India:**

 
 
• The Chief Justice of India (CJI) is the head of the judiciary of India and the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The CJI is responsible for the allocation of cases and appointment of constitutional benches that deal with important matters of law.
 
• They hold the position until they reach the age of 65.
 
 
 
• **Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG):**
 
 
• The CAG is an authority, established by the Constitution of India, who audits all receipts and expenditure of the Government of India and the state governments.
 
• The CAG is also the external auditor of government-owned corporations and conducts supplementary audits of government companies.
 
• The CAG is appointed for a term of six years or until the age of 65, whichever is earlier.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister:**
 
 
• The Prime Minister of India is the head of government and is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The Prime Minister leads the executive branch of the Government of India and is the chief advisor to the President of India.
 
• The Prime Minister is usually the leader of the party or coalition that has a majority in the Lok Sabha.
